title: Recent Progress for Single-Molecule Magnets Based on Rare Earth Elements
claim: Acetylacetonate ligands, after loss of the enolic hydrogen in base, give stable O,O-bidentate chelates and a simple, high-yield route to Ln complexes.
explanation: Section 3.1 describes the keto-enol tautomerism of 1,3-dicarbonyls and states that alkaline deprotonation produces a stable chelate with high yield and strong complex stability, initiating acac-based SMM chemistry.
conditions: Alkaline conditions are required for deprotonation to the bidentate chelate.
caveats: Magnetic performance is not guaranteed by the ligand class alone and depends on the completed coordination geometry.
